nodes.description: Constant of 86400 seconds used to floor timestamps to whole days and to scale the vesting period.
Immutable IERC20 token held by the timelock and distributed to the beneficiary.
Immutable address that receives the released benefit tokens.
Immutable timestamp when the linear release period begins (day-aligned).
Timestamp when the release period ends; end of full release, mutable by terminate().
Total amount of tokens that the beneficiary is entitled to; reduced by terminate().
Running total of tokens already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating that the contract has been terminated by the owner.
Owner address inherited from Ownable, controls the onlyOwner restricted functions.
Constructor initializing token, beneficiary, release window and total benefit and validating the window against block.timestamp.
View computing the linearly vested amount available for withdrawal at the current block.timestamp.
View returning _totalBenefit minus the currently released balance.
View returning the amount already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Public function that pays the vested delta to the beneficiary and updates _withdrawedBalance.
Owner-only termination that caps the benefit at the released amount and sends remaining tokens to the owner.
View returning the held IERC20 token.
View returning the beneficiary address.
View returning the total benefit amount.
Inherited modifier enforcing that the caller equals owner().
Inherited view returning the current owner address.
Private inherited helper writing _owner and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Modifier requiring that _isTerminated is still false.
Caller controlled address, used for ownership initialization and access control checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp controlling vesting math and the terminate() release window reset.
External ERC20 transfer of the vested amount to the beneficiary inside withdraw().
External ERC20 transfer of leftover tokens to the owner inside terminate().
External balanceOf call on the held token used to size transfers in withdraw() and terminate().
Constructor parameter for the ERC20 token address.
Constructor parameter for the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter for the start of the release period.
Constructor parameter giving the duration of the lock in days.
Constructor parameter giving the total token benefit amount.
Parameter of transferOwnership holding the new owner address.
Local amount of vested tokens computed and transferred in withdraw().
Local leftover token amount sent to the owner in terminate().
Local number of elapsed days since _releaseStartTime in releasedBalance().
Local total number of days of the release window in releasedBalance().
Local cache of the previous owner inside _setOwner.

edges.reason: token_ constructor parameter is stored into the immutable _token state variable.
beneficiary_ constructor parameter is stored into the immutable _beneficiary state variable.
releaseStartTime_ is day-aligned and stored into _releaseStartTime.
daysOfTimelock_ is multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to compute _releaseEndTime.
totalBenefit_ constructor parameter is stored into _totalBenefit.
newOwner parameter flows into the privileged _setOwner ownership writer.
Constructor uses _msgSender() as the initial owner input.
Constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp, a timestamp dependent check.
_msgSender() is passed into _setOwner during construction.
onlyOwner compares owner() against the caller supplied _msgSender().
onlyOwner reads owner() as part of the privilege check.
owner() view returns the _owner state variable.
_setOwner writes the privileged _owner state variable.
oldOwner local caches _owner before the ownership update.
terminate is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
terminate is guarded by the isNotTerminated modifier.
isNotTerminated reads the _isTerminated flag.
terminate sets _isTerminated to true.
terminate uses block.timestamp to reset _releaseEndTime, a timestamp dependency.
releasedBalance branches on block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency influencing payouts.
releasedBalance reads _releaseStartTime for the elapsed time computation.
releasedBalance reads _releaseEndTime to detect the fully released case.
releasedBalance scales _totalBenefit by the elapsed fraction of the period.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY is used to convert elapsed seconds into days.
terminate uses SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to floor block.timestamp to a day boundary.
Constructor uses SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to align the release start and compute the end time.
passedDays local is part of the releasedBalance return expression.
totalDays local is the denominator of the releasedBalance return expression.
passedDays is derived from block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
passedDays is derived from _releaseStartTime.
totalDays is derived from _releaseEndTime.
totalDays is derived from _releaseStartTime.
unreleasedBalance calls releasedBalance.
unreleasedBalance subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit.
withdrawedBalance returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable.
token() returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable.
totalBenefit() returns the _totalBenefit state variable.
withdraw requires releasedBalance() to exceed the withdrawn balance.
withdraw reads and updates the _withdrawedBalance state variable.
amount equals releasedBalance() minus the already withdrawn balance.
amount deducts the current _withdrawedBalance.
_withdrawedBalance is incremented by the amount local variable.
withdraw hands control to the external token contract during safeTransfer, a reentrancy surface.
The computed amount is the value sent in the external token transfer.
The immutable beneficiary is the recipient of the external token transfer.
The held token contract is the target of the safeTransfer call.
withdraw queries the external token balanceOf before transferring.
balanceOf is invoked on the held token contract.
amountToWithdraw is computed from the capped _totalBenefit value.
amountToWithdraw subtracts _withdrawedBalance from the capped benefit.
amountToWithdraw uses the external balanceOf result as the source of leftover tokens.
terminate sets _totalBenefit to the currently released balance.
terminate mutates the _totalBenefit state variable.
terminate mutates the _releaseEndTime state variable.
owner() is the recipient of the leftover token transfer.
amountToWithdraw is the value sent in the owner token transfer.
terminate hands control to the external token contract during safeTransfer, a reentrancy surface.
The held token contract is the target of the terminate safeTransfer call.
terminate queries the external token balanceOf to size the owner transfer.
